newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat holds talks with Egypt after Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Arafat holds talks with Egypt after Hebron deal.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Wednesday for talks on Middle East peace after Israel handed over most of the West Bank town of Hebron to the PLO, presidential sources said.
They said Arafat, who arrived early this morning from Italy, held talks with Mubarak at the Ittihadiya presidential palace.

Arafat reclaimed Hebron on Sunday after months of bitter negotiations with Israel's right-wing leader Benjamin Netanyahu. The Palestinian leader has said the handover would be a springboard for further Israeli withdrawal from the West Bank.

Egypt, which sees itself as an unofficial sponsor of the Middle East peace process, supported the Palestinians in their Hebron negotiations and Arafat regularly consults with Mubarak about the peace talks.
